description.value: Fresh Press Coffee Bar is an independent, locally rooted café that has been serving the Richmond area since 2012, with a focus on ethically sourced coffee brewed fresh-to-order. The Alderbridge location offers house-made baked goods and cakes alongside its coffee menu. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a convenient stop on a ride through central Richmond.
